about: A day given its own title here and nothing else, then the whole series renamed at Google, not yet read: Google writes the new title into the day's record too, so the day is the series' own values there again and the stored read takes its row away. Then that day's notes changed through its own row, as the app sends it: the page's unlikely refusal for an edited day whose row is gone once the read is stored with nothing to ask, google_conflict, nothing sent, the read stored (Slice 2, the unlikely list; x-choice). The same sequence is case 10's (kept and named) when the request names the day by the repeating event and its key.
